# Evidence
- Problem class: degradation-flags-dropped-in-retrieval-orchestrator
- Model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
- Solved: 2026-10-13T04:28:57.939Z
- Verification: solution produced by pi in sandbox; see signatures.json

signatures.description: Retrieval orchestrator detected the vector-lane FTS fallback marker (SearchResult.Metadata[degraded]=no_embedding_fallback_fts) but never propagated it to run.DegradationFlags, so API meta.degraded stayed false while results silently came from FTS. Fix in internal/retrieval/execute.go collectCandidatesIndividual: append vector_lane_fts_fallback to run.DegradationFlags per-result and merge roundResult.DegradationFlags into run.DegradationFlags deduped after each round.
